task: showing a wrapped gift box with a ribbon bow

steps.description: Person holds the wrapped gift box with a pink ribbon bow above the table, tilting it slightly.
Person rotates the gift box, flipping it to show its side.
Person flips the box over to show the back, then turns it end over end.
Person tilts the box at an angle and moves it around while the other hand hovers beneath it.
Person holds the gift box upright-facing with the bow on top and presents it.

task: Presenting a wrapped gift and laying out gift-wrapping supplies on a table

steps.description: Person holds and tilts the wrapped gift with a pink ribbon bow above the wooden table.
Hand sets down or rolls the wrapping paper roll on the table next to the white box.
Hand places the pink ribbon spool on the table.
Hand places scissors at the top of the table.
Hand places the tape roll on the table, blurred by motion.
A blue stapler appears on the table between the box and paper roll.
The ribbon spool is removed and put back flipped, showing the pink side with a logo.
Items are picked up and cleared from the table, leaving the box and paper roll.

task: wrap a boxed item in white paper (gift wrapping demonstration)

steps.description: Hand rests on and nudges the patterned box on the table beside the paper roll.
Both hands pick up the patterned paper roll from the table.
Unrolls and spreads the white paper sheet across the table while the box is held at the top.
Picks up the box and places it, flipped with its black side up, in the center of the white paper.
Starts rolling or folding the left edge of the paper toward the box.
Folds and rolls both side edges of the paper inward, showing the patterned side.
Smooths the paper and folds the right edge over to match the left side.
Presses the right rolled edge over the box and slides the paper toward the box.
Adjusts the box and paper, drawing them together while the rolled edge stays on the left.

task: Rolling and unrolling a patterned paper sheet around a black rectangular object on a wooden table (paper magic trick)

steps.description: Hands enter and start working on the paper's right edge as the left edge is already rolled.
Hands curl the right edge of the paper upward and inward, starting a roll beside the black object.
Right hand steadies the black object and right roll while the left roll stays in place and the paper is repositioned.
Fingers touch and adjust the black object and the right-side paper roll.
Paper is lifted and moved across the black object, partially covering it.
Hands quickly shift the paper and rolls, repositioning the sheet to the left.
Right hand pulls and flattens the paper to the right, leaving a roll on the left.
Hands curl the right edge of the paper into a roll again while holding the sheet in place.

task: Wrapping a black rectangular box in patterned wrapping paper

steps.description: Hands rest on the right edge of the paper while the box sits on the white paper, with the left side already rolled up. The camera view shifts slightly.
Hands bring the right edge of the paper over the box and roll the paper toward the left.
Hands wrap the paper around the box and smooth it down. The box is partly visible in the gap.
Fingers press and align the paper edges along the seam over the box. The black box is covered.
Hands smooth the wrapped paper, then fold the paper end and crease it.
Hands press and hold the wrapped package, then pinch and fold the end flap in.

task: folding or wrapping a sheet of patterned paper into a long flat rolled shape on a wooden table

steps.description: Fingers press and crease the paper edge at the top of the folded paper strip while the other hand holds it down.
Both hands turn the paper strip over and reposition it along the table, so it lies lengthwise.
One hand holds each end of the paper tube while it is straightened.
One hand presses along the paper's top surface and the other presses the bottom end to flatten the fold and crease.
The strip is shifted and rotated on the table, with one hand steadying it and the other pressing along its side.
Hands hold the top and bottom ends to align and check the paper tube.
The roll is laid at an angle and a finger runs or presses along its surface to smooth it, then it is returned to vertical.
The right hand rests on and smooths the paper, then releases it.
The hand leaves the frame, then returns holding a dark pen toward the top edge of the paper.

task: cutting a strip of patterned paper to make a handle for a paper gift bag

steps.description: Hand presses and folds the paper along its length while scissors rest at the top edge.
Hand holds the folded paper flat on the table as the scissors are positioned at the top end.
Scissors cut a narrow strip off the top end of the folded paper while the hand holds the paper steady.
The main paper is lifted and moved aside, leaving the cut strip on the table.
The paper is put back on the table next to the strip, which forms a loop handle.
Left hand holds the paper at its bottom end while the right hand holds scissors above it; the strip is no longer visible at the end.

task: wrapping a box in patterned wrapping paper

steps.description: Left hand holds the paper edge while the right hand cuts the excess wrapping paper with scissors.
Cut paper flap is folded and creased over the end of the box while scissors are held aside.
Hand presses and smooths the paper around the box end while the scissors are held in the other hand.
Scissors trim the paper at the box end while the left hand holds and rotates the box.
Paper end is folded down against the box and pressed flat.
Both hands press and smooth the paper on the box, then the box is repositioned.
Box is tilted upright and held while the end flaps are folded and pressed.

task: wrapping a rectangular box in patterned paper (folding and tucking the end flaps)

steps.description: Holds the wrapped box upright on the table while the fingers work on the top end flap.
Tilts and rotates the box to expose the end with its flaps, and adjusts the grip.
Folds and creases the paper at the top end of the box, pressing the flap down with the fingers of the right hand.
Presses the paper flat along the box edge while the left hand steadies the top.
Lifts and flips the box over to bring the open end up and into view, which shows the dotted end panel.
Pinches and folds the end flap down, with the left hand working the flap and the right hand holding the box.

task: wrapping a box in patterned wrapping paper (folding and securing the paper at the end of the box)

steps.description: Holds the box upright on the table while the right hand lifts the paper flap at the end.
Pinches and folds the paper flap at the box end and creases it down, with one hand steadying the box.
Presses and smooths the folded paper flap against the box while the other hand holds the box.
The upper hand lets go and pulls away while the other hand keeps the box steady.
The upper hand returns, pinches and refolds the paper flap at the box end, and presses it flat.
Pinches the folded paper edge and works on securing it, apparently with tape, while the other hand holds the box.

task: handling and manipulating a deck of playing cards (card trick demonstration)

steps.description: Both hands hold the deck upright on the table, with the fingertips working at the top edge of the deck.
The right hand pushes the deck across the table and shifts it right while the left hand drops out of view.
The deck is held tilted on its edge and slid further right across the table.
Both hands press and reposition the deck, then settle it upright on its edge, held by the right hand.
The right hand steadies the deck while the left fingers at the top edge pick at or adjust the cards.
Both hands square and tilt the deck, with the fingers handling the top corner of the cards.

task: wrapping a box in patterned gift wrapping paper

steps.description: With the box standing on its end, both hands pinch and fold the paper at the top end of the box.
Fingers press and crease the paper flaps down at the top of the box while the box is held steady.
Both hands pleat and tuck the paper at the top end, smoothing the folds against the box.
One hand holds the box while the other presses and adjusts the paper fold at the top.
The box is tilted and rotated in the hands to bring another end into position.
Both hands hold up the wrapped box at an angle to show it.

task: wrapping a gift box and applying pink ribbon

steps.description: Holds the wrapped box upright on its end, showing the wrapped sides.
Tilts the box against the table and presses the paper down with the right hand, while the left hand pinches the top end.
Turns the box over in both hands to inspect the wrapped sides.
Sets the box flat on the table and smooths it with both hands before pulling them away.
Puts the pink ribbon spool on the table in front of the box.
Points at the box, then lays the ribbon end across it.
Pulls the ribbon from the spool and wraps it around the box while the right hand holds the box.
Holds the ribbon in place on the box while the loose end hangs toward the spool.

task: wrapping a gift box with ribbon

steps.description: Holds the ribbon end against the top of the wrapped box while the ribbon spool sits on the table.
Cuts the ribbon with scissors held in the left hand while the right hand holds the ribbon loop.
Puts the scissors down on the table and brings the hands back to the box.
Presses and smooths the cut ribbon end onto the box with the fingers to secure it.
Turns the box over to reach the other side.
Works the ribbon on the underside of the box, pulling and adjusting it while holding the box.
Pulls the ribbon taut around the box and lifts the box to wrap it.

task: wrapping a gift box with paper and tying a pink ribbon

steps.description: Holds the gift box and pulls the pink ribbon around it, flipping the box to wrap the ribbon along its sides.
Places the box on the table and presses it with the right hand to keep the ribbon band in place while the left hand adjusts.
Turns the box and aligns the ribbon crossing on top, smoothing it with the hands while the spool unrolls.
Pulls the ribbon ends up and crosses and loops them on top of the box to tie a knot.
Pulls the ribbon taut, then the hand moves out of frame toward the scissors.
Holds scissors against the ribbon on the box to cut it.
